data.plainLyric:
I feel it sometimes, it's too much
Oneurui dapdo moreun chae naeiri wa
Naui stage apen big wave
Geu anui neoramyeon duryeopji anajyeo
Nugudo daesinhal su eomneun jigeumui seontaege
Naneun ojik neoreul mitgo can’t stop, won’t stop
Balkkeute nameun mangseorim
Neukkyeojineun gravity
Ijeonui nareul tteona if i’m with you
(Take me) imi ttwieodeun nal
(Lead me) ieojin gyeoreul ttara
(Make me) uriui boneul tteo
Nal matgilge
Won't you call my name?
Hemaeiji anke
Nae modureul georeo on the stage, on the stage
Geop eopsi nareul naedeonjyeo
I will find my way
Ne moksorireul ttara
Geugeomyeon dwae i’m diving for, diving for
Just for you
Neol mannalge
Gyeonggyeneun nal jaba duji mothae
I'll fight, I'll fight until I reach you
Hwaksilhaejyeo eotteon byeonsudeuldo
Naegen amureon himdo eopseo
I can’t stop can’t stop uriraneun hwaksini deun sungan
Risk it risk it all naega han seontaekdeurui daega
Geu modeun geose daehan dabi doelge from now
Geujeo nae ireumeul bulleojwo
(Take me) imi ttwieodeun nal
(Lead me) ieojin gyeoreul ttara
(Make me) uriui boneul tteo
Nal matgilge
Won't you call my name?
Hemaeiji anke
Nae modureul georeo on the stage, on the stage
Geop eopsi nareul naedeonjyeo
I will find my way
Ne moksorireul ttara
Geugeomyeon dwae i’m diving for, diving for
Just for you
Neol mannalge
Now I've found my way
Meomchuji ana nan
Onmomeul deonjyeo idaero
Du bari dachi anado (diving for, diving for)
And now
I close my eyes
Geugeomyeon dwae i’m diving for, diving for
Just for you
I'll see you there
